items.title: fix(plugins): show why a stale registry refresh was refused (#198839)
items.summary: fix(plugins): show why a stale registry refresh was refused (#198839) fix(plugins): show the registry refresh freshness error in text mode When `openclaw plugins registry --refresh` could not confirm the refreshed registry as fresh, text mode threw a plain error, so the user saw only "The CLI command failed." and the doctor hint. The existing message, naming the plugin that differs and saying "Stop plugin package changes, then run `openclaw plugins registry --refresh` again.", was printed only with --json. It is now raised as an expected CLI error, so text mode shows it too. No new text. Evidence: source tier with isolated state and a local plugin whose manifest was replaced with valid alternatives during a real refresh. Base text mode printed only the generic failure; this change prints the existing reason. A clean refresh and the --json failure behave the same on both. Vitest-source: the regression fails on base and passes here (20/20). Full build and packed smoke pass. Net 0 test lines. The one red check, check-test-types, is inherited from main (receipt: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/198839#issuecomment-6878978457). Details: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/198839#issuecomment-6878672891. Thanks @wangmiao0668000666. Co-authored-by: Ayaan Zaidi
